the
power of
darkness?!
My EXP went up,
but
this feels
creepy!

danger
and traps. We
should
probably leave
it
alone...

power!
So this is

My EXP went up,
but

Nothing
happened...
I feel
disappointed
and relieved at
once.

Hmm... What is
this?
It smells so
nice and
makes me feel
good!

english:
I know this
smell!
It is Taiki! I
want to
play with him
again.
My friendship
went up!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm reaction; wrapped to 15 columns for the fixed-width story renderer.

english:
Heehee! I am so
happy
today. We can
all live
peacefully
thanks to
Taiki. I want
to thank
him somehow!

english:
Taiki, thank
you so
much for
everything!
We are all
grateful.
I hope you
heard me!
My friendship
went up!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm reaction; wrapped to 15 columns for the fixed-width story renderer.

Bits!

them to
Taiki right
away. He
will be so
happy!

them to
